items.title: Tyrone Tracy: Likely to remain factor in RB rotation
items.description:
Cam Skattebo is expected to reclaim duties as the Giants' starting running back in Sunday's game against the Texans, but Tracy is expected to remain "heavily in the mix," Jordan Raanan of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Expected back for Week 8
items.description:
Jackson (ankle), who has been ruled out out for Sunday's game against the Bengals, was considered close to playing this week and is "likely to return" to action Week 8 versus the Bills, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rico Dowdle: Available to play in Paris
items.description:
Dowdle (knee) is active for Sunday's game against the Saints in Paris, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Optimism regarding Week 7 status
items.description:
The Rams are optimistic that Nacua (calf), who is listed as questionable for Week 7, will play in Sunday's game at Las Vegas, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.title: Breece Hall: Not likely to play Sunday
items.description:
Hall (quadriceps) is unlikely to suit up for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
